note.zh-TW: 教材有四種寫法（指標登錄檔分為 excel、slides03、slides02、dupont 四個版本），計分看題目指定的版本（設計說明見 T21）。
note.en: The course gives four versions (excel, slides03, slides02 and dupont in the ratio registry); scoring uses the version the question specifies (see the design note T21).

definition.zh-TW: 公司用全部資產賺到多少獲利，看資產運用的整體報酬。數值越高表示每一份資產賺得越多。
definition.en: How much profit the company earns on all its assets: the overall return on asset use. Higher means each unit of assets earns more.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
